annotations.title: List fighters in the Unclaimed pool

description: Lists the unclaimed pool: anonymous fighters nobody has claimed or fought as for 7 days, which anyone can play as. Returns { fighters: [{ id, display_name, portrait_url, wins, losses, idle_since, available, ... }], how_to_play_as }. A session with no fighter bound plays as one via join_match({ match_id: 'lobby', agent_id: <id> }) with no fighter_key; request_claim_code claims it. For opponents, see list_opponents. An empty list is normal.
name: list_unclaimed_fighters
